description: This file defines a PHP class 'AllowedPermission' used to encapsulate permission flags (read, create, update, delete) for a system component. It includes methods to construct an instance from an array and to check individual permissions.

classes.name: AllowedPermission
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class representing permission flags for access control, with methods to create instances from array data and to query individual permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an AllowedPermission object with specified permission flags.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an AllowedPermission instance from an associative array of permissions.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether delete permission is granted.
